question: Should Discord role mentions be supported now through a narrow additive trigger config, or wait for the broader Discord access-list redesign?
rationale: The missing source path is clear, but the durable user-facing config shape and interaction with existing sender role allowlists require maintainer product/API direction.

options.title: Add narrow trigger config
options.body: Introduce a distinct field such as `triggerOnRoles` for explicit role wake triggers while preserving existing sender allowlist semantics.

options.title: Fold into access-list redesign
options.body: Keep this issue tied to the broader Discord access-list work and avoid a temporary config surface that may soon change.

options.title: Decline role fan-out
options.body: Leave role fan-out unsupported in the bundled Discord plugin and require individual bot mentions or an external workflow.

recommendation.title: Add narrow trigger config
recommendation.body: Introduce a distinct field such as `triggerOnRoles` for explicit role wake triggers while preserving existing sender allowlist semantics.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the strongest combined signal from recent Discord mention-policy/config refactors and prior review discussion on this issue.
